items.item_text: Completion of Certified Medical Assistant Program
Basic Life Support - CPR - authorized by the American Heart Association

Updates demographic data and collects clinical information from each patient and/or parent as to the reason for the visit and enters this information into the chart clearly and concisely 95-98% of the time. Reviews medical record to ensure that all medical reports are accurately compiled and available for the provider before the patient examination 95-98% of the time.
Performs and documents weight and vital signs on all patients per Clinic policy with no more than 1-2 errors in a 6 month period.
Greets and responds to the public in a friendly, respectful manner so that the incidents of valid customer complaints are no more than 1-2 per year.
Maintains smooth patient flow to maximize the utilization of the providers time by processing patient within 10 minutes after admission.
Anticipates provider needs for treatment of patient and assists with medical procedures with no more than 1-2 provider complaints per year.

Performs simple tests such as vision and hearing screening, dipstick urinalysis, and pregnancy tests with 96-98% accuracy; results are documented in patient's medical record with no more than 1-2 omissions per year.
